machine: Apple M4 Max: 14 CPU cores (10 performance, 4 efficiency), 36 GB memory, 32-core GPU
measured: 2 November 2026, zone network, eleven-round games, 64 simulations, depth 16, 64 wide, two message layers, fresh networks: 124 games per hour with learning at these settings.
The same layout evaluating on the GPU (neural_device mps) played 58.7 games per hour, and ten processes each evaluating their own games 84.
The coordinator that evaluates every game's positions was busy 89% of the time, so it limits this layout.
notes: python: PyTorch 2.14 from requirements-gpu-mps.txt, which the GPU needs for long runs; the numbers above were measured with it.
unset_environment: agent shells set MallocNanoZone=0, which slows the allocator and costs 26 to 29% more CPU.
keep_awake: caffeinate keeps the Mac awake while the supervisor runs.
The 12 cores and 30 GB are the owner's allowance; the supervisor's --all-cores uses all 14 cores when the owner allows it.
